mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(`date`, '%Y-%m-%d') AS orderDate, COUNT(*) AS orderQuantity FROM fc_fish_order WHERE ground_id = #{groundId} AND del_flag = 0 AND status in ('1', '3') AND `date` >= CURDATE() AND `date` < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(`date`, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT ffb.id AS boatId, ffb.boat_number, ffb.`status`, ffb.capacity, ffb.remark, ffo.id AS orderId, DATE_FORMAT( ffo.`date`, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS orderDate, IF( ffo.id IS NULL, 0, 1 ) AS reserve FROM fc_fish_boat ffb LEFT JOIN fc_fish_order ffo ON ffo.boat_id = ffb.id AND ffo.del_flag = 0 AND ffo.status in ('1', '3') AND DATE_FORMAT( ffo.`date`, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = #{orderDate} WHERE ffb.ground_id = #{groundId} AND ffb.del_flag = 0 AND ffb.status = '1'

SELECT id, ground_id, ground_name, `date`, boat_number, name AS orderName, phone AS orderPhone, fare AS orderFare, `status`, IF(modify_count > 0, 1, 0) AS orderModify, modify_count AS orderModifyCount FROM fc_fish_order WHERE del_flag = 0 AND status = '1' AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY `date` DESC

SELECT ffo.id, ffo.ground_id, ffo.ground_name, ffo.`date`, ffo.boat_number, ffo.name AS orderName, ffo.phone AS orderPhone, ffo.fare AS orderFare, ffo.`status`, IF(ffo.modify_count > 0, 1, 0) AS orderModify, ffo.modify_count AS orderModifyCount, ffg.phone, ffg.address FROM fc_fish_order ffo LEFT JOIN fc_fish_ground ffg ON ffg.id = ffo.ground_id AND ffg.del_flag = 0 WHERE ffo.del_flag = 0 AND ffo.status = '1' AND ffo.id = #{id}

SELECT id, user_id, realname, ground_id, ground_name, `date`, boat_id, boat_number, phone FROM fc_fish_order WHERE del_flag = 0 AND status = '1' AND ground_id = #{groundId} AND `date` >= CURDATE() ORDER BY `date` DESC
